version: version must be a positive safe integer at most 9007199254740991
workflow name: name must match ^[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
unknown field: Use only these fields: format, workflowId, workflowVersion, description, useWhen, root, handlers, progressRecord, configuration, sections, orchestrator, workflowArgs, threadTypes, focusAreas, lifecycles.
nested unknown field: Use only these fields: id, type, description, values.
configuration key: configuration key must match ^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(?:\.[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)+$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
duplicate ID: Choose an unused workflow ID. This ID first appears at $.lifecycles["change"].steps["draft"].id.
reserved name: name must match ^[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)*$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
constructor name: name must match ^[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)*$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
prototype name: name must match ^[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)*$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
guard reference: when must name a declared guard or condition
guard cycle: guard expressions must not contain a cycle at ready
branch condition: multiple branches require when naming a declared guard or condition, except a final else
step completion in on: completion trigger cannot appear in on
terminal path: non-terminal state needs an ordinary transition path to a terminal state
initial reachability: state must be reachable from initialState by ordinary transitions
non-string mapping key: mapping keys must be string scalars (plain or quoted)
trigger unused: Use this trigger in on, anyState, or a step completedBy.
heading missing: section heading must occur exactly once: heading is missing
unknown document: Document provider must return readable text for absent. Check the document name and read access. Provider error: Error: absent.
handler source: Handler provider must return readable text for unavailable. Check the handler name and read access. Provider error: Error: unavailable.
handler path: name must match ^[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*(?:\.[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*)?$ and cannot be free, declare, override, __proto__, constructor or prototype
repeated YAML key: Use one valid YAML 1.2 document with unique keys, no aliases, anchors or tags. Parser DUPLICATE_KEY: Use unique mapping keys. Map keys must be unique at line 2, column 1:\u000a\u000aformat: 1\u000aformat: 1\u000a^\u000a
YAML anchor: aliases, anchors and tags are forbidden
YAML alias: aliases, anchors and tags are forbidden
unknown YAML tag: Use one valid YAML 1.2 document with unique keys, no aliases, anchors or tags. Parser TAG_RESOLVE_FAILED: Remove the unsupported tag. Unresolved tag: !unknown at line 4, column 14:\u000a\u000adescription: !unknown Test workflow\u000a             ^^^^^^^^\u000a
multiple documents: workflow must contain exactly one YAML document
bad configuration type: configuration type must be boolean, enum or text
enum values missing: enum requires a nonempty list of text values
values on boolean: values are allowed only for enum configuration
argument type: argument type must be integer, text, enum or list
focus class: focus class must be design-triggering or reviewer-only
guard unknown: expression must name a declared condition or guard
guard expression shape: guard expression must name a declared condition or guard, or use { not: expr }, { and: [expr, expr, ...] } or { or: [expr, expr, ...] }
condition guard namespace: Give this guard a name that no condition in this lifecycle uses.
step predicate: step condition must be { key, equals: value }, { key, in: [values] } or { key, present: true }
step configuration: must name a declared configuration key
branches empty: branches must be a nonempty list
else order: else must be last after a guarded branch
terminal on: terminal state cannot have on or call
call cycle: lifecycle calls must not contain a cycle at change
priority: priority must be a safe integer at most 9007199254740991
id range: id must be a positive safe integer at most 9007199254740991
explicit YAML tag: aliases, anchors and tags are forbidden
